results.content:
The distinction matters. Sample delivery does not guarantee a production contract, while mass shipment does not reveal customer allocations. However, SK hynix now has one generation entering volume deployment as its successor moves through customer testing. [...] The central development is not one early sample. SK hynix is overlapping the HBM4 production ramp with HBM4E qualification.

SK hynix said in its July 29 quarterly results that it began mass HBM4 shipments during the second quarter. The company plans to expand production during the second half of 2026. [...] Its HBM4 ramp supplies another important test. The company began mass shipments during the second quarter and plans to increase production in the second half. It has not disclosed quarterly HBM4 volume, customer mix, or yield.

A smooth HBM4 expansion would strengthen confidence in related process, packaging, and supply decisions. Delays or allocation changes would raise questions about how quickly SK hynix can move HBM4E into production.

results.title: SK hynix Developing New NAND Products for KV Cache ...
results.content:
KV cache is temporary data required for graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle AI computations. As AI data surges, the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity for storing KV cache is reaching its limits. In response, SK hynix plans to develop new products that mount high-capacity NAND products near the GPU, allowing them to serve as an additional KV cache repository. [...] SK hynix (000660.KS) said on the 29th during its second-quarter earnings conference call that it is developing new NAND product families such as "near-GPU storage" driven by key-value (KV) cache offloading.
